title: Humans Spot Deepfakes Only 55% Of The Time
hook: Humans catch deepfakes only 55% of the time.
closing: Seeing a video is no longer enough; verify before you trust or share it.
question: Could you spot a deepfake?

segments.say: Online deepfake videos reached 95,820. The flood grew more than sixfold, overwhelming human review.
Humans detect deepfakes only 55% of the time. A convincing fake is barely easier to spot than chance.
Deepfake-enabled fraud cost the US $12.3 billion. Synthetic video now carries a real financial price.
